chapterInfo.content:
16
Onyankopɔn hunu nnipa nneyɛɛ
1Akoma mu nhyehyɛɛ yɛ onipa dea,
na tɛkyerɛma mmuaeɛ firi AWURADE.
2 # Mmb 21.2 Onipa akwan nyinaa so te n’ani so,
na ahonhom karifoɔ ne AWURADE.
3 # Dwom 37.5 Fa wo nnwuma hyɛ AWURADE nsa,
na wo nhyehyɛɛ bɛtim.
4AWURADE yɛ ade nyinaa ma botaeɛ bi nti,
ɔbɔnefoɔ mpo ma da bɔne.
5 # Mmb 11.21 Obiara a ɔyɛ akoma mu dwɛɛ yɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
ampa ara, ne ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
6Wɔde adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ kata amumuyɛ so,
na wɔde AWURADE suro kwati bɔne.
7 # Gye 31.24; 33.4 Sɛ onipa akwan sɔ AWURADE ani a,
ɔma n’atamfo mpo ne no ntam ba asomdwoeɛ.
8 # Mmb 15.16 Tenenee mu ade ketewa yɛ
sene nnɔbaeɛ pii a ɛmfiri tenenee mu.
9 # Mmb 19.21 Onipa akoma na ɛdwene ne kwan ho,
na AWURADE na ɔsisi n’anammɔn.
10Nkɔmhyɛ wɔ ɔhene anomu,
atemmuo mu nso n’ano mfom.
11 # Mmb 11.1 Abrammoɔ ne nsania tee yɛ AWURADE dea,
fotoɔ mu aboɔ nyinaa yɛ ne nnwuma.
12 # Mmb 20.28; 25.5; 29.14 Ahemfo akyiwadeɛ ne abɔnefosɛm die,
na tenenee mu na akonnwa tim.
13Ahemfo anisɔdeɛ ne ano tenenee,
na deɛ ɔka deɛ ɛtene no, wɔdɔ no.
14 # Mmb 20.2 Ɔhene anibereɛ yɛ owuo abɔfoɔ,
na ɔba nyansafoɔ pata no.
15 # Mmb 19.12 Ɔhene animteɛ mu na nkwa wɔ,
na n’anisɔ te sɛ bereamporɔberɛ mu mununkum.
16 # Mmb 3.14; 8.10—11.19 Sɛdeɛ nyansanya yɛ sene sika fa!
ne nhunumunya sɛ wɔyi sene dwetɛ.
17Teefoɔ tempɔn ne bɔne kwatie,
deɛ ɔhwɛ ne kwan kora ne kra.
18 # Mmb 18.12 Ahantan di ɔsɛeɛ anim,
na dwɛɛ honhom di asehweɛ kan.
19Ɛyɛ sɛ wo ne mmɔborɔfoɔ nya ahobrɛaseɛ honhom
sene sɛ wo ne ahokyerɛfoɔ bɛkyɛ asadeɛ.
20Deɛ ɔdwene asɛm soɔ no hunu papa,
na nhyira ne deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ.
21Wɔfrɛ akoma mu nyansafoɔ sɛ nhunumufoɔ,
na ano dɛdɛ ma adenim dɔ.
22 # Mmb 13.14; 14.27 Nimdeɛ yɛ nkwa nsutire ma deɛ ɔwɔ,
na agyimifoɔ deɛ, wɔn asotwe ne wɔn agyimisɛm.
23Onyansafoɔ akoma kyerɛ n’ano nimdeɛ,
na ɛma adenim dɔ wɔ n’anomu.
24 # Mmb 12.25 Nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ yɛ ɛwoɔkyɛm,
ɔkra adɔkɔdɔkɔwadeɛ ne nnompe nkwahosan.
25 # Mmb 14.12 Ɛwɔ ɔkwan bi a ɛtene wɔ onipa ani soɔ,
na mmom n’awieeɛ yɛ owuo kwan.
26 # Mmb 18.7 Odwumayɛni kɔm yɛ adwuma ma no,
ɛfiri sɛ n’ano piapia no.
27Obusuyɛfoɔ bɔre bɔne,
na n’ano te sɛ ogya a ɛhyehyeɛ.
28 # Mmb 6.14, 19 Onipa kontonkyi hyɛ takrawɔgyam,
na asomsɛmkani tete nnamfo ntam.
29 # Mmb 1.10-14 Omimdifoɔ sisi ne yɔnko,
na ɔde no fa kwan a ɛnyɛ so,
30 # Mmb 6.13 ɔmua n’ani dwene akontonkyisɛm ho,
ɔwe n’ano wie bɔneyɛ.
31 # Mmb 20.29 Abotire a ɛyɛ fɛ ne ɛdwono,
wɔhu no tenenee kwan so.
32 # Mmb 14.29 Deɛ ne bo kyɛre fuo no yɛ sene dɔmmarima,
na deɛ ɔdi ne honhom soɔ no sene deɛ ɔko fa kuro.
33Srɛ so na wɔtwe tonto,
na atemmuo nyinaa firi AWURADE.

pageProps.chapterText:
Akoma mu nhyehyɛɛ yɛ onipa dea,
na tɛkyerɛma mmuaeɛ firi AWURADE.
Onipa akwan nyinaa so te n’ani so,
na ahonhom karifoɔ ne AWURADE.
Fa wo nnwuma hyɛ AWURADE nsa,
na wo nhyehyɛɛ bɛtim.
AWURADE yɛ ade nyinaa ma botaeɛ bi nti,
ɔbɔnefoɔ mpo ma da bɔne.
Obiara a ɔyɛ akoma mu dwɛɛ yɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
ampa ara, ne ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
Wɔde adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ kata amumuyɛ so,
na wɔde AWURADE suro kwati bɔne.
Sɛ onipa akwan sɔ AWURADE ani a,
ɔma n’atamfo mpo ne no ntam ba asomdwoeɛ.
Tenenee mu ade ketewa yɛ
sene nnɔbaeɛ pii a ɛmfiri tenenee mu.
Onipa akoma na ɛdwene ne kwan ho,
na AWURADE na ɔsisi n’anammɔn.
Nkɔmhyɛ wɔ ɔhene anomu,
atemmuo mu nso n’ano mfom.
Abrammoɔ ne nsania tee yɛ AWURADE dea,
fotoɔ mu aboɔ nyinaa yɛ ne nnwuma.
Ahemfo akyiwadeɛ ne abɔnefosɛm die,
na tenenee mu na akonnwa tim.
Ahemfo anisɔdeɛ ne ano tenenee,
na deɛ ɔka deɛ ɛtene no, wɔdɔ no.
Ɔhene anibereɛ yɛ owuo abɔfoɔ,
na ɔba nyansafoɔ pata no.
Ɔhene animteɛ mu na nkwa wɔ,
na n’anisɔ te sɛ bereamporɔberɛ mu mununkum.
Sɛdeɛ nyansanya yɛ sene sika fa!
ne nhunumunya sɛ wɔyi sene dwetɛ.
Teefoɔ tempɔn ne bɔne kwatie,
deɛ ɔhwɛ ne kwan kora ne kra.
Ahantan di ɔsɛeɛ anim,
na dwɛɛ honhom di asehweɛ kan.
Ɛyɛ sɛ wo ne mmɔborɔfoɔ nya ahobrɛaseɛ honhom
sene sɛ wo ne ahokyerɛfoɔ bɛkyɛ asadeɛ.
Deɛ ɔdwene asɛm soɔ no hunu papa,
na nhyira ne deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ.
Wɔfrɛ akoma mu nyansafoɔ sɛ nhunumufoɔ,
na ano dɛdɛ ma adenim dɔ.
Nimdeɛ yɛ nkwa nsutire ma deɛ ɔwɔ,
na agyimifoɔ deɛ, wɔn asotwe ne wɔn agyimisɛm.
Onyansafoɔ akoma kyerɛ n’ano nimdeɛ,
na ɛma adenim dɔ wɔ n’anomu.
Nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ yɛ ɛwoɔkyɛm,
ɔkra adɔkɔdɔkɔwadeɛ ne nnompe nkwahosan.
Ɛwɔ ɔkwan bi a ɛtene wɔ onipa ani soɔ,
na mmom n’awieeɛ yɛ owuo kwan.
Odwumayɛni kɔm yɛ adwuma ma no,
ɛfiri sɛ n’ano piapia no.
Obusuyɛfoɔ bɔre bɔne,
na n’ano te sɛ ogya a ɛhyehyeɛ.
Onipa kontonkyi hyɛ takrawɔgyam,
na asomsɛmkani tete nnamfo ntam.
Omimdifoɔ sisi ne yɔnko,
na ɔde no fa kwan a ɛnyɛ so,
ɔmua n’ani dwene akontonkyisɛm ho,
ɔwe n’ano wie bɔneyɛ.
Abotire a ɛyɛ fɛ ne ɛdwono,
wɔhu no tenenee kwan so.
Deɛ ne bo kyɛre fuo no yɛ sene dɔmmarima,
na deɛ ɔdi ne honhom soɔ no sene deɛ ɔko fa kuro.
Srɛ so na wɔtwe tonto,
na atemmuo nyinaa firi AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
